study: Same automatic meaning plans as advisory context for base and preserved Saudi LoRA variants
scope: Development-only; no new training or model promotion is implied
plans: Unedited original planning.py output for the four exposed dev.json cases. Use only the generated facts/acts/avoid JSON, never the teacher's final reply. Plans remain fallible; no manual correction or oracle.
comparison: Each of five model variants uses the identical policy and identical automatic plan within each condition. Same pinned MLX 4-bit base, greedy decoding, thinking disabled, max_tokens 256. Judge untouched decoded text; clipped output fails.
qualification: Require 4/4 strict development replies. On ties prefer the preserved pilot, then approved v2, then earlier experimental epoch; prefer clean policy. Base-only selection cannot be mislabeled as Saudi LoRA.
further_gates: A qualifying combined system must still pass actual bfloat16 full-pipeline development, known-user UI regressions, the original unused 16-case 13/16 gate and all four intent contrasts, and warm end-to-end latency <=150 seconds before any public change.
interpretation: This evaluates a combined teacher-planning and response-adapter system; it does not prove the small model or adapter alone generalized. Compare the complete configurations and report all components.
reviewer: Assistant; independent human Saudi review pending
failure_policy: Preserve original weights, raw failures and the unopened fresh test. No paid resources or voice-secret transfer.
